purpose: Short four-Firefox synthetic multi-speaker smoke for per-source Opus playback, recovery, room isolation, and single-screen ownership.

tls.trust: local CA imported only into four isolated Firefox NSS profiles; certificate errors are not ignored

syntheticSources.audio: A and B use test-injected getUserMedia oscillator streams through AudioContext MediaStreamDestination; no physical microphone is opened
syntheticSources.screen: A and B use test-injected getDisplayMedia canvas streams; no native picker or physical display is used

limits.realMicrophoneAndHumanListening: not-tested; oscillators are injected synthetic sources
limits.realDisplayCapture: not-tested; getDisplayMedia is replaced with a generated canvas in test pages
limits.physicalNetworkFailure: not-tested; C receives one controlled Playwright WebSocket close
limits.capacityAndEndurance: not-tested; short four-process feasibility flow, no load or long-duration target
limits.persistenceAndCloudDeployment: not-tested; this browser smoke attaches to the externally started local fixture
limits.identity: not-verified; labels identify synthetic browser contexts, not people
